d.ko: Pages of Time: Prologue is a 2D platformer puzzle game. Play as the witch who controls the magic of time, in a beautiful and magnificent magic academy, utilize the skills of recording and rewinding time, solve all kinds of puzzles, and look forward to the adventure of the future.
d.en: Pages of Time: Prologue is a 2D platformer puzzle game. Play as the witch who controls the magic of time, in a beautiful and magnificent magic academy, utilize the skills of recording and rewinding time, solve all kinds of puzzles, and look forward to the adventure of the future.
d.zh: 《时间切片：序章》是一款2D平台跳跃解谜游戏。扮演掌控时间魔法的魔女，在美丽而宏伟的魔法学院中，巧妙地利用记录与回溯时间的技巧，解开各种各样的谜题，憧憬未来的冒险。
